ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Persistence Using DebugPath
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential persistence using Appx DebugPath

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*Classes\\\\ActivatableClasses\\\\Package\\\\Microsoft\\\..*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\DebugPath$")) OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\PackagedAppXDebug\\\\Microsoft\\\..*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\\\(Default\\)$")))
